title: Saving for a Bicycle
sentences: I want to buy a bicycle for going to work.
A good one costs about three hundred dollars.
Every week I put twenty dollars in a small box.
I stopped buying coffee on my way to the office.
That saves me about ten dollars every week.
My sister said I could buy a used bicycle instead.
I looked at some, but they were all too small.
I have saved half of the money now.
In two months I think I will have enough.
Then I will not need to take the bus any more.
